'''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-D-maareksteletheemperorsreach-2022-07-31-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-D-maareksteletheemperorsreach-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V0-D-maareksteletheemperorsreach-2022-07-31-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-D-maareksteletheemperorsreach.gif]], 31 July 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
